engine_provides: HTTP MCP server on configurable port/path (default 127.0.0.1:8000/mcp)
tools/call over SSE with JSON-RPC result
notifications/progress heartbeat when client supplies progressToken
Origin-header DNS-rebinding guard for browser clients
ueremcp_must_build: In-process job registry with stable job_id (envelope job block)
Cooperative cancellation wired from MCP cancel to domain work
Semantic progress mapping (engine heartbeat is not percent-complete)
timeout_ms enforcement returning partially_completed + job handle
Crash recovery is out of scope for Wave 1 — jobs are in-memory only
